semiconductor_relevance: High — Denka manufactures essential materials specifically designed for various stages of the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Denka produces critical materials for semiconductor manufacturing, including high-heat-dissipation ceramic fillers, low-transmission-loss resins for advanced communication technologies, and specialized temporary fixing materials. Their products support applications in AI, 5G/6G communication, and LED technologies, making them a key supplier in the semiconductor value chain.
capabilities: Temporary fixing materials with photocuring/UV laser peeling
